name: Round
description: Circular motor platform with a direct transition into the arm.
controls: Pad width.

name: Rounded square
description: Broad square platform with curved outer corners.
controls: Pad width and corner radius.

name: Chamfered square
description: Square platform with four straight clipped corners.
controls: Pad width and chamfer size.

name: Four-lobe
description: A central hub with four round ears around the fixing holes.
controls: Pad width; ear positions follow the motor pattern.

name: Tapered nose
description: A long, narrow outward tip with clipped inner corners.
controls: Width, corner size, tip extension and optional tip slot.

name: Arrowhead
description: A wider extended tip with sloping sides and clipped inner corners.
controls: Width, corner size, tip extension and optional tip slot.

name: Teardrop
description: A round bearing platform with a tangent transition into the arm neck.
controls: Pad width; neck follows arm width.

name: Shouldered
description: A clipped shield with a tapered neck and broad mounting shoulders.
controls: Pad width and corner/chamfer size.

name: Compact hex
description: Six straight edges around a compact motor platform.
controls: Pad width; fixed outline proportions.

name: Scalloped shield
description: A shouldered shield with circular reliefs at both sides and the nose.
controls: Pad width and scallop/corner size.

name: Crown shield
description: Broad shield shoulders with a single shallow circular recess in the outward nose.
controls: Pad width, scallop depth (corner size), neck length and optional neck reliefs.

name: Twin-scallop shield
description: A compact clipped shield with paired recesses in the side edges.
controls: Pad width, scallop depth (corner size), neck length and optional neck reliefs.

name: Tri-scallop shield
description: Three shallow scallops at the sides and nose of a tapered shield.
controls: Pad width, scallop depth (corner size), neck length and optional neck reliefs.

name: Recessed-nose shield
description: A wide, shallow nose recess leaves two short protective front corners.
controls: Pad width, scallop depth (corner size), neck length and optional neck reliefs.

name: Swept-shoulder shield
description: Long swept shoulders with paired scallops near the forward side edges.
controls: Pad width, scallop depth (corner size), neck length and optional neck reliefs.

name: Waist-scallop shield
description: Rearward side scallops create a waisted transition into the solid mounting deck.
controls: Pad width, scallop depth (corner size), neck length and optional neck reliefs.

name: Broad-crown shield
description: Broad front corners with three small edge scallops and a short flat nose.
controls: Pad width, scallop depth (corner size), neck length and optional neck reliefs.

name: Faceted-scallop shield
description: Angular shield facets with three compact circular edge recesses.
controls: Pad width, scallop depth (corner size), neck length and optional neck reliefs.

name: Round-shoulder shield
description: Curved neck shoulders lead into a shield with a scalloped nose.
controls: Pad width, scallop depth (corner size), neck length and optional neck reliefs.

name: Twin-cheek shield
description: High front cheeks with paired side scallops and a broad outward edge.
controls: Pad width, scallop depth (corner size), neck length and optional neck reliefs.

name: Split-crown shield
description: Two small outward scallops leave a short central crown between them.
controls: Pad width, scallop depth (corner size), neck length and optional neck reliefs.

name: Compact-scallop shield
description: A short clipped shield with broad, shallow paired side recesses.
controls: Pad width, scallop depth (corner size), neck length and optional neck reliefs.
